differentials.candidate_differentials: Exact profile-use binary passes all eight supported compact/wide cases and preserves the known baseline gap; validation executes in preparation and measurement scripts.

application.measurement_scope: Instructions cover the complete command; seconds cover the archive analysis timer. Each process has a fresh TMPDIR. Five files and twenty findings, stderr and status 1 remain identical.

controls.scaling: Shared temporary-read holdout runs 250000 iterations initially and 2500000 in confirmation. Existing property/scalar controls use their original enlarged loop counts. All are excluded from PGO.

phase_counters.counter_scope: Events explicitly enabled at analysis entry and disabled at analysis completion using perf FIFO acknowledgements; startup excluded

profile_evidence.note: Instruction body accounting is a conservative unique-reachability lower bound. Called functions, common executor tails and startup are not included in this individual body cost. Whole-command profiling and phase-only hardware counters have different scopes.

first_cached_attempt.reason: Reference PHP and RPHP shared a temporary directory, so result-cache reuse changed the analysis shape. Preserved and excluded from fresh-cache admission evidence.

diagnostics.note: Feature-enabled diagnostic binaries measure ownership shapes, not candidate time; ordinary builds have no diagnostic scan.

initial_failures.note: PHP destroys the replaced old nested leaf; baseline omits that destructor. Original compact and wide failing specimens and outputs survive. The independent supported replacement test retains an external owner; the unsupported specimen remains explicitly documented, not counted as a PHP pass.

limitations: Overall PHP parity remains incomplete: analysis instruction ratio is about 7.80x.
Native evidence is limited to x86-64; no ARM64 host is configured.
Property-read control time regresses 2.05% in independent confirmation and instructions increase 0.40%.
Scalar-frame control instructions increase 0.79%; time is effectively unchanged.
Known last-owner callback compatibility gap remains byte-identical to baseline and is not a successful PHP differential.
No frame layout, unsafe invariant, JIT admission or public API change.

acceptance.control_tradeoff: Property-read +2.05% time/+0.40% instructions and scalar-frame +0.79% instructions are independently investigated and reproducible. The integrating task accepts them under the user instruction priority in exchange for -2.25% analysis instructions, -2.33% confirmed application time and -17.80% instructions in the independent holdout.
